item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-28
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects in recent weeks. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` project has made iterative improvements to its `data_check` branch, including the addition of an RO-crate metadata file and fixes for regex bugs. Meanwhile, `MicheleNuijten/statcheck` and `giladfeldman/docpluck` have focused on administrative updates and issue fixes, respectively. The `quest-bih/oddpub` project has enhanced its "ontogenerator" component with a code validation update, and `Davidvandijcke/coarse` has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker. These updates demonstrate the connections between our projects and the community's commitment to improving research tools. With synchronized changes in `giladfeldman/escicheck` and updates to `JamieCummins/regcheck`, our community is celebrating a period of notable progress and collaboration.

6 commits across 3 active repositories this week.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was the focus of recent work, with commits aimed at enhancing its functionality. On July 26, the `data_check` branch saw the addition of an RO-crate metadata file, replacing the previous collection.json file, and the removal of the full preview from the archive, along with fixes for regex bugs. Another commit on July 28 to the `data_check` branch introduced "iterative improvements" by Lakens, building upon the previous changes. The `data_check` branch is the only branch that was worked on during this period. No other branches were modified in these commits.

1 commit(s) today:
